lockup.excerpt: The lock-up ends on the earlier of (i) 6:00 a.m. Eastern Time on the second trading day after the Company publicly announces earnings for the quarter ending September 30, 2026, or (ii) 180 days after the date of this prospectus. Staged early releases are documented. This is not a flat 180-day lock-up.
